name: export_worksheet
author: hprebar
title: Export worksheet
description: Export a worksheet or entire workbook to PDF or CSV format on disk. Returns generated file path and size. Takes an automatic snapshot before export.
notes: Uses Worksheet.ExportAsFixedFormat for PDF and SaveAs with xlCSV for CSV export.

outputPath.description: Target destination file path. If omitted, exports beside the workbook.

sheet.description: Worksheet to export. Required for CSV; optional for PDF (exports full workbook if omitted).

workbook.description: Workbook name or file path. Defaults to active workbook.

fitToPage.description: Fit content to 1 page wide (PDF only).
